name: Relax Your Room: Cozy Moods
summary:
Relax Your Room turns the room you are sitting in into the place you need right now.

Tell it how you feel. Your walls take on a soft colour, light settles on your floor, and the room fills: rain falling to your own floor, snow and hanging lanterns, drifting bubbles, golden stars, butterflies landing on flowers beside you. Music made for that mood begins, and the room moves with it.

REACH OUT
• Everything within reach answers your touch with a soft note, always in tune with the music
